stem.text: Equal volumes of five concentrations of sodium chloride solution were placed into five containers. An identical piece of plant tissue was placed into each container and left for 48 hours.
The plant tissues were removed and the volumes of the sodium chloride solution were accurately measured. The results are shown below.

stem.alt: Graph of change in volume of solution in cm3 against concentration of sodium chloride in mol dm-3, with five plotted points joined by a line.

stem.text: Which statements explain the results from 0.80 to 1.00 $\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium chloride?

items: There was no net movement of water into or out of the plant tissues.
The plant root tissues had a water potential of zero.
The plant tissues were fully plasmolysed.
